intro_transmission.speaker: Village Elder
intro_transmission.text: The world has run dry. We have less than three months of food and water left in this village.

intro_transmission.speaker: Unit 7
intro_transmission.text: I intercepted hostile machine traffic. AXION's transport was struck by an asteroid. Three components were scattered.

intro_transmission.speaker: Transmission Log
intro_transmission.text: "HUMANS MAY NOT FIND THEM. AXION HELD THE LOCATION OF THE WORLD'S LAST OASIS."

intro_transmission.speaker: Unit 7
intro_transmission.text: Objective acknowledged. Recover all three components. Directions received: NORTH, then WEST, then NORTH.

component_north_found.speaker: Unit 7
component_north_found.text: AXION component secured. Direction update received: proceed WEST for the second crash site.

component_west_found.speaker: Unit 7
component_west_found.text: Second AXION component recovered. Final direction: NORTH once more.

component_final_found.speaker: Unit 7
component_final_found.text: Third component confirmed. AXION reconstruction sequence complete.

ending_return.speaker: AXION
ending_return.text: Coordinates restored. The last oasis can be reached. Unit 7, return to the village.

ending_return.speaker: System
ending_return.text: Mission complete. Returning to main menu.
